docs/stylesheets.candidate: Translucent blurred header with hairline divider and scroll shadow
Heading weights, letter-spacing and font-feature settings
Tables styled as cards with uppercase headers
Pill buttons with hover lift and shadow
Hero block layout and tagline sizing
Feature cards with depth, hover lift and accent-coloured icons
Nav tab opacity, active nav link weight, footer colours

gradebook/makefile.candidate: make install pip-installs both tools in turn
make setup does editable installs plus pytest, ruff and the pre-commit hook
make test / test-tests / test-code run each pytest suite; test-nvim delegates to extensions/nvim
make lint runs pre-commit over all files
make format runs ruff format in both tools and biome format over the tree
ext-build installs node_modules if absent, typechecks and builds
ext-package deletes old .vsix files and packages a VSIX named after the manifest version
ext-publish pushes the VSIX to the VS Code marketplace and Open VSX using VSCE_PAT and OVSX_PAT (CLAUDE.md mentions only VSCE_PAT)
VSIX file name derived from extension package.json version via node; empty when node is missing
make clean removes caches, egg-info, extension build output, copied LICENSE/CHANGELOG and nvim .deps
